Battle Mender is a temporary PvP title earned by winning 50 Solo Shuffle matches as a healer while at Rival I rank or above (1800+ PvP rating). The title itself is rewarded by achievements for the associated season. Battleground Blitz is a rated PvP mode that players can queue up for solo or as a duo (with a healer required) in an 8v8 match. It features accelerated resource acquisition and modified objectives, offering a more chaotic PvP match. Teams are composed of 2 healers, 5-6 damage dealers, and 0-1 tanks (the opposing team will always match the number of tanks). Matches typically last around 10 to 12 minutes. Cross-faction queuing is available. In , the mode became a permanent rated mode rather than a PvP Brawl and received new rewards for subsequent PvP Seasons since The War Within Season 1.

Beledar ( ), also known amongst the Hallowfall Arathi as "the Emperor's Vision", is an immense glowing crystal lodged into the ceiling of Hallowfall, a large cavern in Khaz Algar. Most of the time, it radiates Holy Light, acting as an inner sun that provides warmth and growth for vegetation, giving Hallowfall a lush climate reminiscent of the surface world. It periodically shifts into a Void state called Beledar's Shadow, in which it radiates corrupting shadow energy. These periods can last anywhere from a few moments to several days. Best In Class is the final in a series of Liberation of Undermine achievements involving hard mode on the One-Armed Bandit boss. There are four colored chips found inside the Gallagio while on the way to the One-Armed Bandit. After collecting one (or more) coins, take them to the slot machines in the room immediately before the boss arena and interact with the same-colored machine to deposit the coin and alter the encounter. In order of increasing difficulty, activate red, gold, blue, then purple chips in that order.
